_readme: EXAMPLE tolerances for the two physical fingerprints PhysyncPreflight v1.3 captures. Copy to your workspace's .physync/fingerprints.json and CHANGE THE NUMBERS AND THE NAME: a tolerance is an engineering decision about YOUR robot's noise floor, and PHYSYNC refuses to invent it. tolerance values are max |delta| per key (0 = exact match required); {"angleDeg": n} compares {x,y,z} values as a 3D angle instead.
